# FacePass v0.1.4

## English

FacePass v0.1.4 fixes a local Mac recognition capture regression where recognition could wait until the timeout before returning, even after an early valid match. The sensitive recognition window remains up to 10 seconds for the first match, and the existing 2-match gate is preserved before recognition can affect approved unlock or prompt-fill flows.

This release also adds an app-target regression test for the capture behavior. There is no expansion of supported targets or unlock scope, and FacePass still does not persist passwords outside Keychain, keep the camera running, or persist raw camera frames or face photos.

## 中文

FacePass v0.1.4 修复了本机 Mac 识别采集的回归问题: 即使较早出现有效匹配, 识别流程也可能等到超时才返回。敏感识别流程仍保留最长 10 秒的首次匹配窗口, 并继续保留现有的 2 次匹配门槛, 之后识别结果才可影响已批准的解锁或提示填充流程。

本版本还为该采集行为新增了 app target 回归测试。支持目标和解锁范围没有扩大; FacePass 仍不会在 Keychain 之外持久化密码, 不会持续运行摄像头, 也不会持久化原始摄像头帧或人脸照片。
